scene otohamaya1
A silent walk through a long corridor was exactly what Otoha Okakura needed after another exhausting day at school.
And while she was no stranger to hard work as she’d been working hard her whole life, she’d grown quite accustomed to her time under the wing of a predatory bird.
She awaited his return with less fervor than the others, as she felt her emotions came across better when reserved for the spaces between blue lines on white paper.
But there was fervor nonetheless. And she didn’t want to accept a future in which she’d need to hunt for her own scraps rather than feasting on the leftovers not consumed by her vulture.
That’s really all he was at the end of the day — a man who swooped down and plucked the meat off of teenage girls who failed to realize they’ve been dead all along.
But here she was — brimming with half a life that felt more like a script and another half that felt like torn up shreds of paper strewn across the floor of a well-furnished living room.
How she wished for the chance and the time to tape them all together and recall what it was she wanted.
But as the sun poured in through the glass and played hell upon her irises, she focused more on the sound of her own footsteps than the beating of her heart.
Until something else caught her attention.
scene otohamaya2

The bright sound of a violin bleeding into that long corridor executed the silence that brought her comfort moments ago and, instead, replaced it with an array of feelings she struggled to immediately comprehend.
So she listened closely. Music was her thing, of course. And, as an artist herself, she felt more inclined to identify with abstract ideas rather than specific dialogues or pesky conversations.
Those were never strong suits of hers. But this...
This was something she could follow.
Not just into the classroom, where she would ultimately move anyway- but on a plane somewhere between the one we know and the one we only sort of know.
And, for the first time since her lips touched those she’d never claim again, her heart skipped a beat.
In fact, it skipped harder than it did that time before because, unlike then, this was real.
This was a moment she’d stolen due to coincidence rather than calculation. Which made stealing it okay, she thought. So she listened for a little while longer.
Until just listening alone was not enough.
scene black
scene otohamaya3
She needed to see the girl. She wanted to observe the look on her face to get a better idea of what these sweet sounds meant.
Because, as bright as they were and as warm as they made her heart, she could tell there was something else.
Complacency, perhaps? Loneliness? She wasn’t sure, as both of these things were things she never felt.
But whatever it was, she wanted to know.
She wanted to reach out and touch the girl in a way unlike she’d touched any other before- though her experience with such a thing was admittedly limited.

This wasn’t sexual, though. But it probably could be if the offer arose, as she was so currently entranced that she’d comply with any of the girl’s desires at the moment if it meant acquiring a taste of her world.
That was all she wanted — a taste. Of whatever this artist felt.
Because it was closer to authentic than anything she’d ever done before. And again, this was her thing.
She wasn’t sure how long she watched her for.
It could have been minutes...hours...days...but probably not days because the bell would certainly have interrupted them.
Right?
Or was this one of those moments she’d heard about in movies — where time comes to a standstill and nothing exists outside of one singular moment.
She wished this would be like that.
The violinist, however-
Did not.
scene otohamaya4
She opened her eyes and looked out the window, but wore an expression so normal that it worked in contrast to the sound of her instrument and racked Otoha’s mind.
Does she feel anything at all?
Is this just some well-rehearsed classical piece she’d never heard before?
Or is it something she simply can not fathom yet?
With so many feelings left unfelt and so many probable precious moments that had flown over her head during those late hours where she’d sit at her desk, she acknowledged this possibility.
She acknowledged how, unlike her, this girl had likely seen things. Done things. But what things? And with whom?
And the fact that she’d been right there, just several desks down this whole time, was terrifying.
She thought, “If there’s been this much untapped beauty right in front of my face, just what else have I been missing out on?”
scene otohamaya5
But that’s the last thing she’s able to think before the girl with the violin notices her.
: I apologize.
: You’ve seen something rather inappropriate just now.
: Inappropriate?...
: Maya...that was beautiful.
scene otohamaya6
: It was muddy.
: Muddy?
: Confused, even.
: I’m not sure what it was trying to say.
: I...I had no idea you even played the violin.
: That’s not much of a surprise to me. Neither one of us knows anything about the other. And why would we? Why should we?
: After today, we’ll likely never speak again.
: You’ll go back to your friends and I’ll go back to mine. And we’ll both go back to feeling things that neither one of us will ever be able to understand.
: I’m sorry again. That was quite gloomy, wasn’t it?
: Do you...
: Do you want to talk?
scene otohamaya7
: About what?
: Anything.
: There’s no club today, so I kind of just...came here to do what you’re doing.
: Oh, right. I forgot there was a light music club at all.
: I’m sorry for commandeering your room. There just wasn’t anywhere else that felt right.
: Don’t worry about it. In fact, I’m...kind of happy you did. Whatever you were just playing was...way more moving than anything else that’s come out of this room so far.
: I take it that means your band isn’t very good.
: Do you want to sit?
scene otohamaya8
: I suppose it wouldn’t hurt.
: If we’re never going to talk again, we may as well make this meeting somewhat special.
scene black
scene otohamaya9
: So...how long have you been playing?
: I...can’t really remember.
: Is it just violin? Can you play piano as well?
: Not very well.
: Do you want me to teach you?
: I appreciate the offer, but I’m fine with the way things are now.
: Just figured I’d ask.
: You know...I don’t think it’s weird. You coming here to play, I mean.
: Why do you think that I would think that you think that is weird?

: Just the...being alone thing. Like, I know what it’s like to feel like you have to hide your music. I kick Nodoka out of the room all the time for that. And I was always quiet about it back at home.
: Some stuff’s just kind of personal, you know?
: I think you might be misunderstanding why I’m here.
: I have no qualms with anyone hearing me play the violin. If anything, it’s probably the safest way for me to talk about my feelings.
: The problem is that I have them. And now I’ve inadvertently dragged an innocent bystander into them after being unable to control whatever impulses made me do this.
scene otohamaya10
: Why wouldn’t it be okay for you to feel?
: It’s less that it’s “not okay” and more that I just hate it. But I suppose feelings are an inevitable part of this curse called youth.
scene otohamaya11
: You’ve got that right.
: I often find myself wishing that this shit would just be over with already so I can get on with my life without all the necessary drama that comes with just being a teenager.
: And here I thought you were all feeding off of such a thing.
scene otohamaya12
: I’m sure that’s how it looked...what with the Rin situation and all of that. But I was never really cut out for that to begin with.
: In fact, I don’t think I’m cut out for any of this. And any time I encounter one of those quintessential teen moments, I can’t help but think, “Wow. I’m really excited for this to end.”
: It’s kind of weird, you know? Like, on one hand, I want to enjoy my youth. But, on the other, it’s all so fucking frustrating.
: Nothing’s as fun as I want it to be and I still find those moments where I’m just...alone writing music to be the most enjoyable of all.
: But then I do that and I feel like I’m wasting away my high school years and it becomes this confusing, shitty paradox I don’t know how to escape from.
scene otohamaya13
: But you helped me with that just now. So thanks.
: Listening to you play was the first time in a while that I’ve felt any peace.
scene otohamaya14
: It’s the opposite for me, unfortunately.
: What do you mean?
: I mean that I feel no peace at all right now. And, without divulging any of the specifics to you, this is the most conflicted I’ve felt in a long time.
: Is that what you were trying to get across with the violin?
: Maybe. I’m not really sure.

: I think I was just hoping a certain someone would hear it. But of course that would have been too cliché to actually happen and now I’ve gone and wasted the big, emotional moment on another heroine instead.
: Well, your sacrifice won’t go unappreciated. I kind of needed something like this. I just didn’t really expect you of all people to be at the forefront of that.
scene otohamaya15
: And I can’t say having you walk in on me was anywhere on my bingo card.
: You must not be very good at bingo, then. I come here more often than anyone, you know.
: I’ll keep that in mind the next time I have an overwhelming urge to play the violin.
: I’ll be sure to come by even more often then. I wouldn’t want to miss another chance to hear you.
: Interesting...
: Interesting?
: It's just, if I didn’t know any better...I’d think you were flirting with me right now, Otoha.
: Hey, nobody said two heroines can’t end up together. Maybe your big, emotional moment wasn’t wasted at all?
: Ahh, I see. So apparently I don’t know any better and you are flirting with me right now.
: Only if it’s working.
: If there wasn’t already a vice grip latched onto my heart, it might be. I do like the cool, asshole type after all.
scene otohamaya16
: Alas! ’Twas not a fateful encounter at all, but one more fleeting moment of anguish in this curse called youth...
scene otohamaya17
: I get it, though. I also have a thing for the cool, asshole type. But I imagine I’m chasing after a different one than you.
scene otohamaya18
: I find that hard to believe given the general disposition of literally every single girl in our class.

: But also, don’t read into that statement because this is kind of a part of me that I’m supposed to keep secret and I’m only giving you a glimpse of it because you happen to be here when I’m most vulnerable.
: I get it. And don’t worry, I’m not going to say anything.
: You’ve got your work cut out for you, though. Especially given recent developments.
scene otohamaya19
: It’s everyone else who has their work cut out for them. I have a natural advantage given the fact that I’m the cutest and the smartest.
: And great at violin too. Anyone would be lucky to have you.
: If only anyone would suffice. Vice grips are a terrible thing.
: They really are...aren’t they?
scene otohamaya20
: So, if you’re not chasing after the same person as everyone else...who are you chasing after? It’s not still Rin, is it? Because I certainly wouldn’t describe her as “cool.” Or an asshole, really.
: Secret, right?
: Of course. Everything we say and do in this room will be erased once we leave today.
: Does that mean we can make out?
scene otohamaya21
: So it’s been me all along. Poor Rin. But I suppose she deserves this for getting my character killed.
: Hahah...no, it’s not you.
scene otohamaya22
: It’s some jerk with pink hair.
scene otohamaya23
: Noriko? Seriously? You’re a trillion leagues above her.
: Try older.
: Older? But that’s-
scene otohamaya24
: Wait...you don’t mean...
: Kumon-mi’s very own sweetheart. The idol who holds dominion over the hearts of all.
: Spoiler alert. She’s kind of an asshole in real life.
: You have the actual worst taste in women ever and I am kind of offended that you want to make out with me now.
: I take it you’re not a fan of hers then?
scene otohamaya25
: I sometimes have dreams where I strap her to a rocket and launch it into the sun.
: That seems...a little excessive. But the heart wants what the heart wants, I guess.
: Point is, though...I get where you’re coming from.
scene otohamaya26
: And in a roundabout way, this means we can sort of root for one another.
: Just your goal seems a lot more obtainable than mine.
scene otohamaya27
: It’s those damn vice grips again. I’m telling you, they ruin everything.
: Mhm...
: But in the event that all else fails-
: If you ask me to make out again, I’m pretty sure it will count as sexual harassment and I will be forced to report this to the authorities.
: Doesn’t mean I can’t think it.
scene otohamaya28
: Okay. For your sake, I think it’s about time we leave. I don’t want you doing anything stupid.
: But then I’ll have to go back to not knowing you.
scene otohamaya29
: It’s for the best, I assure you. I’m not the type of person you should want to associate with.
: Oh yeah? And why’s that?
scene black
: Because it’ll make everyone else seem so much worse.
The day ends.
But at least something good happened along the way.
